description: Where an airplane is usually based: the field its past flights (as ADS-B receivers heard them) most often take off from or land at. Each flight's ends are its takeoff field and, where it was heard landing, its landing field. A field is the base where at least min_ends (3) of the ends are there, at least min_share (0.4) of all the ends are, and no other field has as many; otherwise `ident` is null and nothing is said. The figures are the owner's (2026-10-13), not the FAA's: no public data says where an airplane is kept.

flights.description: The airplane's past flights, any order; each field one identifier, as the host names it.

origin.description: The field it took off from; null where not known.

destination.description: The field it landed at; null where not known.

landed.description: Whether it was heard landing: a destination not landed at is no end.

ident.description: The base; null where the flights do not show one clearly.

most.description: The field most of the ends are at (the first to reach the count, ties too); null with no ends.

most_ends.description: How many of the ends are at `most`.

ends.description: All the takeoffs and landings counted.

min_ends.description: The fewest ends at a field for it to be the base.

min_share.description: The least share of all the ends at a field for it to be the base.
